product_rsc.title: Lipotropic B
product_rsc.description: Lipotropic B is a liquid research blend with two formulations: Cyanocobalamin B12 (Original) and Methylcobalamin B12 (New). The Original formulation contains eight listed components, with the following nominal amounts per milliliter of solution: L-carnitine 20 mg, L-arginine 20 mg, methionine 25 mg, inositol 50 mg, choline 50 mg, vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) 25 mg, vitamin B5 (dexpanthenol) 25 mg and vitamin B12 (cyanocobalamin) 1 mg. The Original formulation is labeled as a 10 mL unit. Its single-unit offer contains one unit, and its 10-pack contains ten units of that same formulation, totaling a nominal 100 mL. These concentrations and volume apply to the Original formulation; they are not assigned to the New Methylcobalamin formulation. The published cyanocobalamin sample report lists identity and other tests but no numeric purity percentage. Both formulations have single-unit offers and matching 10-unit packs.
